name: NevoMove
summary: NevoMove is a mobile RPG that turns your real-world steps into in-game progress. The more you walk, the stronger your Nevomon gets. Explore your surroundings to discover portals, capture creatures ranging from common to legendary, and build a team that matches your playstyle. Every Nevomon has unique traits that affect how it fights and evolves, giving you full control over your strategy. You can challenge other players in ranked online battles or jump into casual duels with friends. The game also features daily missions, equippable Arches that add buffs and bonuses, mini-games to earn rewards, and a built-in step tracker to follow your activity over time. A global chat and private messaging let you stay connected with the community. Everything is free to play with no paywalls blocking core content.
